body: A Web UI for easy subtitle using whisper model.
plain_description: Whisper WebUI lets you generate accurate subtitles and transcriptions from audio and video files using AI — no technical expertise required. It supports multiple languages, identifies different speakers, and removes background noise for cleaner results. Run it locally, in Docker, or on Google Colab.
technical_description: Whisper WebUI is a Gradio-based browser interface for OpenAI's Whisper speech recognition model that provides subtitle generation from files, YouTube URLs, and microphone input. The application supports multiple Whisper inference backends — openai/whisper, faster-whisper (default), and insanely-fast-whisper — with faster-whisper providing reduced VRAM usage and improved transcription speed via CTranslate2. Audio pre-processing capabilities include Silero VAD for voice activity detection and UVR for background music separation. Post-processing supports speaker diarization via pyannote models. Text translation is available through Facebook NLLB models and DeepL API. Deployment options include Docker Compose, local Python environment, Pinokio, and Google Colab. A FastAPI-based REST API backend is available for service-oriented deployment.
title: Whisper WebUI
